scripts.dev:tunnel: sh -c 'HOST_IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || ipconfig getifaddr en1); EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=${EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL:-http://$HOST_IP:8788}; export EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL; expo start --dev-client --tunnel --clear || expo start --dev-client --host lan --clear'
scripts.dev:lan: sh -c 'HOST_IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || ipconfig getifaddr en1); EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=${EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL:-http://$HOST_IP:8788}; export EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL; expo start --dev-client --host lan --clear'
